summary.text: Jo Jones, listed by Ballotpedia as Jolanda Jones, is a Democratic state representative and lawyer who has represented Texas House District 147 since May 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously served on the Houston City Council and the Houston Independent School District board.

paragraphs.text: Jolanda Jones graduated from Alief Elsik High School and earned a B.S. in political science and government in 1989 and a J.D. in 1995, both from the University of Houston.
Her career experience includes owning and working as a lawyer with the Law Office of Jolanda Jones.
Jones served on the Houston City Council from January 2008 to January 2012 and on the Houston Independent School District board, District IV, from 2016 to 2020.
She succeeded Garnet Coleman in representing District 147 and assumed office on May 18, 2022.

She defeated Claudio Gutierrez in the November 5, 2024 general election and advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary; Theodis Daniel is the Republican candidate in the 2026 general election.
